hypothesis: Previous-year native forest context improves prediction over static 1984 context enough to justify annual data cost, on identical incidents.
target: NFDB agency-reported size >=10 ha, conditional on eligible recorded fire
limitations: Static versus prior-map-year context on common eligible incidents only.
Annual product is retrospective/temporally smoothed; earlier map labels do not guarantee contemporaneous availability or freedom from future information.
Agency-associated date and reported-size proxy; no daily forecast or causality claim.
Chronological discovery years reused; final-test performance sealed.
rejection_rule: Retain static context unless annual tree AP gains at least 0.01 on average, wins at least two of three fold means and subsequently survives a frozen guarded spatial check.
